findings.passage: I would vote against HB 133. After Parkland, Florida raised the purchase age from 18 to 21 because it saved lives. Weakening that law puts communities at risk. Responsible gun ownership requires safeguards that reflect the reality of gun violence in our state. We should be strengthening red flag laws, improving background checks, and investing in mental health, not rolling back proven safety measures.
findings.note: Answer in a newspaper candidate questionnaire. She says she would vote against HB 133 (lowering the rifle and shotgun purchase age from 21 to 18), and that red flag laws and background checks should be strengthened.
